title: V2 model discovery, profile duplication, and wide-screen shell layout optimizations
userOutcome: Add model discovery from upstream provider, profile duplication with secret reuse, fluid wide-screen shell layout, and sticky sidebar navigation.

results.note: Scope validation passes with all modified files declared in manifest.

results.note: Fix round: complete sticky range for the sidebar (sidebar height subtracts the page bottom padding so sticky travel equals the full scroll distance) and lift the V2 shell above the fixed theme-decoration layer so animated particles no longer paint over the sidebar/content.

results.command: pnpm --filter @living-network/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @living-network/web lint && pnpm test:e2e
results.note: Fix round 2: compact the sidebar navigation (group gaps, heading margins, paddings; short-viewport media query keeps links at 36px min-height) so the nav fits fully at 768px laptop height with no internal scrollbar or clipped items; move the model settings '获取模型' button beside the input so the required-star label no longer wraps.
